# The accessibility tree reports the bottom buttons at 0,0, so taps by label miss. Keep the raw tree to see why.
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 10
dumpxml onboarding
sh input touchscreen swipe 540 2200 540 2200 180
sleep 2
sh input touchscreen swipe 540 2200 540 2200 180
sleep 2
sh input touchscreen swipe 540 2200 540 2200 180
sleep 2
sh input touchscreen swipe 540 2200 540 2200 180
sleep 3
shot after_next
dumpxml onboarding_later
back
sleep 2
shot home
dumpxml home
